a.note: the behaviour before the cue study under the app's configuration: sentence chunking, text-derived frame cap with no cue allowance, codec silence stop, duration retry only, no loop guard

c.note: a with the whole line as one chunk (the reference's 300-byte chunking)

d.note: a with the Space's sampling: temperature 1.0, top-p 0.9, top-k off

e.note: retry a chunk that stopped without eos, and stop a chunk whose main tokens cycle

f.note: a with cue text normalised: lowercase, no spaces inside brackets, opening styles mapped to the official tag list

e2.note: e narrowed: retry a chunk that missed eos only when it spoke under 1.0 of its expected seconds, or when the loop guard stopped it

he2.note: e2 plus 1.5 s of cap per bracket cue: the shipped defaults

dhe2.note: the Space's sampling with he2: temperature 1.0, top-p 0.9, top-k off, cap per cue, narrowed eos retry, loop guard
